mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity`) AS activity_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration`) AS registration_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE status = 1) AS pending_audit_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS today_new_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS today_new_activities, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT organizer_id) FROM `activity` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND status IN (2, 3, 4, 7)) AS weekly_active_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(NOW())) AS monthly_registrations

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.description, a.organizer_id AS organizerId, u.nickname AS organizerName, a.activity_date AS activityDate, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, CONCAT(a.activity_date, ' ', a.start_time) AS startTimeCombined, a.max_participants AS maxParticipants, a.current_participants AS currentParticipants, a.difficulty_level AS difficultyLevel, a.fee, a.equipment_requirement AS equipmentRequirement, gp.gathering_address AS startLocation, a.status, a.reject_reason AS rejectReason, a.audit_by AS auditBy, a.audit_time AS auditTime, a.create_time AS createTime FROM `activity` a INNER JOIN `user` u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `gathering_plan` gp ON a.id = gp.activity_id
a.status = 1
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND a.difficulty_level = #{query.difficultyLevel}
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 0) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 1) AS organizers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 2) AS admins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE status = 0) AS disabled

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity`) AS total_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration`) AS total_registrations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `check_in_record`) AS total_checkins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(NOW())) AS new_users_this_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(NOW())) AS new_activities_this_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE status = 4) AS completed_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE status = 3) AS ongoing_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(NOW())) AS new_registrations_this_month

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) AS new_users_this_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) AS new_activities_this_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration` WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) AS new_registrations_this_month

SELECT a.id, a.title, COUNT(r.id) AS registrations, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rv.overall_rating), 1), 0) AS rating FROM `activity` a LEFT JOIN `registration` r ON a.id = r.activity_id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN `review` rv ON a.id = rv.activity_id WHERE a.status IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY a.id, a.title ORDER BY registrations DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT u.id, u.nickname AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS activities, IFNULL(SUM(a.current_participants), 0) AS total_participants FROM `user` u INNER JOIN `activity` a ON u.id = a.organizer_id AND a.status IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY total_participants DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE difficulty_level WHEN 1 THEN '休闲' WHEN 2 THEN '简单' WHEN 3 THEN '中等' WHEN 4 THEN '困难' WHEN 5 THEN '极限' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity`), 1) AS percent FROM `activity` GROUP BY difficulty_level ORDER BY difficulty_level

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `registration` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM `registration` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS active_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE status = 4) AS completed_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `activity` WHERE status IN (2, 3, 4)) AS published_activities, (SELECT IFNULL(AVG(overall_rating), 0) FROM `review`) AS avg_rating, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(user_id, '-', activity_id)) FROM `check_in_record`) AS checkin_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `registration` WHERE status = 1) AS approved_registrations
